items.text: Deep Cogito raised $43 million to develop AI models designed to improve themselves through iterative learning.
items.text_zh: Deep Cogito 融资4300万美元，用于开发可通过迭代学习实现自我改进的AI模型。

items.text: Hugging Face began using the open-weight Inkling-Small model to turn research-paper abstracts into concise summaries.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face开始使用开放权重模型Inkling-Small，将研究论文摘要转化为简明解读。

items.text: GitHub introduced Agentic Workflows for automating code changes, organization-wide rollouts and code-quality assessments at scale.
items.text_zh: GitHub推出Agentic Workflows，用于自动修改代码、在组织范围内推广变更并规模化评估代码质量。

items.text: AWS added AgentCore Evaluations for assessing agents built with any framework through configurable evaluators and production monitoring.
items.text_zh: AWS推出AgentCore Evaluations，可通过自定义评估器和生产环境监控，评测使用任意框架构建的智能体。

items.text: Google Research introduced GlucoFM, a foundation model for extracting health insights from continuous glucose-monitoring data.
items.text_zh: Google Research发布GlucoFM基础模型，用于从连续血糖监测数据中提取健康洞察。

items.text: VS Code added a rubber-duck command that asks a complementary model to review agent work for missed details and edge cases.
items.text_zh: VS Code新增“橡皮鸭”命令，可调用另一个模型复查智能体工作，寻找遗漏细节和边界情况。

items.text: Runway added Meta’s Muse Image to its platform alongside its existing image and video generation models.
items.text_zh: Runway将Meta的Muse Image接入平台，与现有图像和视频生成模型一同提供。

items.text: Bolt introduced an agentic security audit that scans applications, applies patches and hardens detected vulnerabilities.
items.text_zh: Bolt推出智能体安全审计功能，可扫描整个应用、自动打补丁并加固发现的漏洞。

items.text: Gemini Live added autonomous multi-step tasks, Gmail actions, Daily Brief access and personalized assistance based on previous conversations.
items.text_zh: Gemini Live新增自主执行多步骤任务、操作Gmail、访问每日简报，以及基于历史对话的个性化协助。

items.text: Anthropic gave independent researchers access to privacy-preserved Claude usage data for studying collaboration, wellbeing and real-world productivity.
items.text_zh: Anthropic向独立研究人员开放经过隐私保护的Claude使用数据，用于研究人机协作、身心感受和现实生产力。

items.text: Harvey and Fireworks post-trained Tenet from Kimi K3 for long-horizon legal work, nearly doubling fully passed benchmark tasks at similar cost.
items.text_zh: Harvey与Fireworks基于Kimi K3后训练法律模型Tenet，以相近成本将基准测试中完全通过的任务数提高近一倍。

items.text: Goodfire presented a more token-efficient method for identifying chain-of-thought branching tokens that materially alter model outcomes.
items.text_zh: Goodfire提出一种更节省令牌的方法，用于识别会显著改变模型结果的思维链分叉令牌。

items.text: Devin sessions can now launch managed subagents with separate virtual machines, and those child sessions can spawn further subagents.
items.text_zh: Devin会话现在可以启动拥有独立虚拟机的托管子智能体，而且子会话还能继续创建更多子智能体。

items.text: Harvard Business School used HeyGen LiveAvatar to create interactive AI avatars of professors for its Foundry entrepreneurship program.
items.text_zh: 哈佛商学院通过HeyGen LiveAvatar为教授制作互动式AI化身，并应用于Foundry创业项目。
